SCRIPT-DNA skill build Config: …

Strips any narrated or rhetorical script — video-essay narration, true-crime script, self-help monologue, sermon, explainer, ad copy — to its generative skeleton, separating the invariant structure (beat sequence, rhetorical devices, rhythm, voice contract) from the disposable vessel (specific subject, facts, citations, names). Reforges the result as a fillable, topic-agnostic template that can regenerate a new script on any subject while preserving the genre's feel. The narrative-genre sibling of core-extractor — same sideways, preserve-the-operation philosophy, applied to prose/spoken artifacts instead of code/engines.
